review_candidates.description: At the American Cancer Society, we're working to end cancer as we know it, for everyone. Our employees and 1.3 million volunteers are raising the bar every single day. We are a culture comprised of diverse backgrounds and experience, to better serve our communities. The people who work at the American Cancer Society focus their diverse talents on our lifesaving mission. It is a calling. And the people who answer it are fulfilled. The Creative Director is a senior creative leader responsible for translating enterprise creative strategy into breakthrough creative ideas, campaigns, content, and storytelling across assigned mission pillars, brands, or initiatives. Reporting to the Group Creative Director, this role leads day-to-day creative development, brings a high level of conceptual thinking to the work, sets direction for integrated work, and ensures creative excellence from concept through execution. The Creative Director is a player–coach: able to originate strong creative concepts themselves while also shaping, fostering, and elevating ideas from the team. They are deeply involved in developing the work and setting a clear creative vision, while empowering art directors, designers, and copywriters to push ideas further and deliver great work. ***This is a remote position that can be home-based anywhere within the United States. MUST have fluency in written and verbal English & Spanish languages.*** Essential Functions Creative Leadership & Execution (35%) Lead the creative development of campaigns, content, and storytelling initiatives from concept through execution. Translate enterprise creative strategy and brand vision into compelling ideas, narratives, and creative systems that drive mission impact and business objectives. Team Leadership & Creative Direction (25%) Provide day-to-day creative leadership to assigned creative teams, including art directors, copywriters, and designers. Guide work through ideation, iteration, and refinement, ensuring a consistently high creative bar while fostering collaboration, accountability, and professional growth. Conceptual Development & Craft Excellence (20%) Originate and elevate creative concepts, messaging frameworks, and visual approaches across channels and formats, including TV/video, social, digital, experiential, print, out-of-home, and integrated campaigns. Partner directly with editors, designers, and producers to ensure storytelling, tone, and craft meet creative and brand standards. Cross-Functional Collaboration (10%) Collaborate closely with Marketing & Brand Strategy, Social, Core Pillars, and other business partners to align creative vision with executional realities. Clearly communicate creative intent, provide actionable feedback, and help navigate constraints without compromising creative quality. Brand Stewardship & Quality Control (10%) Ensure all creative work aligns with brand voice, visual identity, accessibility standards, and inclusive storytelling practices. Review and approve creative work at key milestones, escalating strategic decisions to the Group Creative Director as needed. Key Responsibilities Lead creative development for assigned campaigns and initiatives Concept and create at a high level while also directing, shaping, and elevating the work of creative teams Translate high-level creative direction into executable concepts and systems Work directly with editors, writers, and designers to shape and refine work Provide clear, constructive creative feedback that improves outcomes Partner with Production to ensure creative intent is preserved through execution Present creative work confidently to senior stakeholders Mentor and develop creative talent through coaching and example Uphold creative, brand, and accessibility standards across all deliverables Qualifications & Skills Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish Education: Bachelor’s degree in Advertising, Graphic Design, Communications, or related field (or equivalent professional experience 5+ years of experience in creative leadership roles (agency or in-house) with overall 10+ years of creative experience. Proven ability to lead integrated campaigns and content across channels Strong conceptual thinking, storytelling, and visual literacy. Candidates may come from a copywriting or art direction background but should be proficient in both disciplines and able to effectively lead and direct both. Experience working directly with editors and production teams Excellent communication and presentation skills Ability to balance creative ambition with executional realities Demonstrated commitment to inclusive, accessible, and mission-driven storytelling An exceptional portfolio that demonstrates: Best-in-class conceptual thinking, creative craft and taste High-performing paid social and digital campaigns Integrated brand storytelling across channels Evidence of creative leadership that elevated both the work and the people behind it. TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS: Approximately 10-20% travel required for shoots, events, and creative team meetings. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: Work is primarily performed in a typical office environment. Frequent sitting and computer use; occasional standing, walking, or lifting up to 15 lbs The starting rate is $97,000 to $121,000 annual. ACS provides staff a generous paid time off policy; medical, dental, retirement benefits, wellness programs, and professional development programs to enhance staff skills. Further details on our benefits can be found on our careers site at: jobs.cancer.org/benefits. We are a proud equal opportunity employer.

review_candidates.title: Associate/ Vice President, Global Client Sales Department, Global Markets Division for Asia
review_candidates.description: Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count? Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world. With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career. Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded. An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Global Markets Associate to join a highly respected financial institution in Hong Kong, supporting the HK Blue Chip and Non-Bank Financial Institution (NBFI) sector portfolio. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and is passionate about building strong client relationships while delivering exceptional service across a range of market-related products. The organisation is renowned for its supportive leadership, commitment to professional development, and inclusive culture that values every team member’s contribution. With flexible working opportunities and access to ongoing training, you will be empowered to grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact within a global network. Join a reputable financial institution with a strong presence in global markets, offering you the chance to work alongside knowledgeable professionals and expand your industry expertise. Benefit from an inclusive and supportive workplace culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and personal growth through comprehensive training opportunities. Enjoy flexible working arrangements designed to help you balance your professional ambitions with your personal commitments, ensuring your wellbeing is always prioritised. What you'll do: As a Global Markets Associate, you will play an integral role in supporting the sales activities of the HK Blue Chip and NBFI sector portfolio. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve promoting a wide array of market-related products while independently executing complex trades with precision. You will be expected to provide valuable assistance to senior team members during high-level pitches by preparing insightful materials and contributing fresh perspectives. Staying attuned to market trends will enable you to sustain strong client relationships, while your commitment to compliance ensures that all activities are conducted ethically. By collaborating with regional teams, you will help expand the organisation’s global reach. Your involvement in management reporting and special projects will further contribute to the overall success of the team. Support sales business activities within Global Markets by assisting the HK Blue Chip and NBFI sector portfolio in achieving key performance indicators and budgetary targets through effective teamwork. Promote a diverse range of market-related products including foreign exchange, FX derivatives, interest rate derivatives, and securities products to activate customer business and foster long-term relationships. Independently execute flow trades involving FX, FX derivatives, and interest rate derivatives for the HK Blue Chip and NBFI sectors, ensuring accuracy and compliance at all times. Demonstrate a proven track record of smooth trade execution by meticulously preparing pre- and post-trade documentation and diligently following up on all transactions. Provide essential support to senior colleagues such as Vice Presidents or Directors during complex solution pitches by preparing marketing materials, simulating market scenarios, and sharing innovative ideas within the team. Stay informed about market data movements and client activities to maintain robust client relations and proactively identify new business opportunities. Uphold full compliance with prevailing regulations by exemplifying ethical behaviour and adhering strictly to all internal controls established for the team. Collaborate effectively with colleagues in other regions to enhance the organisation’s business network and capture additional global business flows through shared knowledge. Take responsibility for management information reporting requirements and actively participate in ad hoc projects or assignments as needed to support broader team objectives. What you bring: To excel as a Global Markets Associate, your background should reflect substantial experience within banking or global markets environments where you have demonstrated proficiency in sales functions. Your academic achievements—ideally complemented by professional certifications such as FRM or CFA—will underpin your technical expertise. Regulatory awareness is vital; therefore holding appropriate licences is mandatory. Your ability to communicate complex ideas simply will set you apart when engaging clients or supporting senior colleagues. A collaborative spirit coupled with meticulous attention to detail ensures that you can manage multiple priorities efficiently while contributing positively to team dynamics. Familiarity with Bloomberg systems alongside advanced Microsoft Office skills will streamline your workflow. Multilingual abilities further enhance your capacity to build rapport across various client segments. A university degree in banking, finance or a related discipline provides you with a solid academic foundation for this role. Possession of FRM or CFA qualifications would be considered advantageous for demonstrating advanced industry knowledge. A minimum of 3 to 5 years’ experience in banking or global markets, particularly with hands-on sales experience, equips you for success in this position. Holding HKMA Type 1 & 4 licences is essential for meeting regulatory requirements within Hong Kong’s financial sector. A thorough understanding of industry trends, product offerings, relevant laws, and regulations enables you to navigate complex market environments confidently. Excellent written and verbal communication skills allow you to convey intricate concepts clearly and intuitively to clients and colleagues alike. Exceptional teamwork abilities are crucial for fostering positive relationships within the group while maintaining great attention to detail across multiple tasks. Proficiency in Bloomberg terminals as well as Microsoft Office applications ensures efficient handling of daily operations and reporting duties. A mature approach combined with proactive problem-solving skills empowers you to work both collaboratively within teams and independently when required. Strong organisational capabilities paired with fluency in English, Cantonese, and Mandarin facilitate seamless communication across diverse stakeholders. We regret to inform that only shortlisted applicants will be notified.

review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders)
review_candidates.description: Be part of the cloud evolution - Let's develop together! Wir treiben in Deutschland die Digitalisierung voran. Hierfür brauchen wie Deine Begeisterung und Unterstützung. Wir bieten Dir ein Umfeld, das Kreativität, den Austausch von innovativen Ideen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen unseren Teams fördert. Du bekommst Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die Dich inspirieren werden, mit den modernsten Technologien vielfältige Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu finden uns umzusetzen. Deine Aufgaben In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du Verantwortung für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung skalierbarer Cloud-Infrastrukturen auf Basis von AWS. Als Senior DevOps Engineer (all genders) bist Du für die Konzeption, Implementierung und den stabilen Betrieb moderner Cloud- und Plattformlösungen verantwortlich und gestaltest aktiv effiziente Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse mit. Du baust AWS‑native Plattformen, inklusive Networking, Security, Compute und Data Services, und stellst deren Skalierbarkeit, Verfügbarkeit und Betrieb sicher. Du baust und betreibst robuste CI/CD‑Pipelines auf Basis vonGitLab— vollständig automatisiert, reproduzierbar und sicher. Du automatisierst Infrastruktur, Deployments und Plattformprozesse mit Python und AWS CDK auf AWS‑native Weise. Du verantwortest Observability für unsere AWS‑Plattformen (CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus) und leitest daraus Optimierungen ab. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Entwickler:innen, Architekt:innen und ProductOwnern stellst Du einen reibungslosen Produktionsbetrieb sicher. Du setzt AWS-Sicherheitsstandards um — inklusive IAM‑Design, Secrets Management, Auditability (CloudTrail) und Härtung produktiver Umgebungen. Du betreibst containerisierte Workloads auf AWS (ECS, Fargate, EC2) und entwickelst dafür automatisierte Deployment‑ und Betriebsprozesse. Ergänzend dokumentierst Du Systeme, Prozesse und Architekturen nachvollziehbar und strukturiert. Außerdem evaluierst Du neue Technologien und Tools, um unsere Plattform kontinuierlich zu optimieren. Deine Erfahrung bringst Du gezielt ein, um Architekturentscheidungen mitzugestalten, Standards zu etablieren und die technische Qualität nachhaltig zu sichern. Technologien und genaue Aufgabenbereiche können je nach Kundenprojekt variieren und bringen somit immer wieder die Chance, Neues zu lernen. Dein Profil Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung (mindestens 4 Jahre) mit AWS, Python und Infrastructure as Code (insbesondere AWS CDK) mit und setzt diese gezielt zur Automatisierung und zum Aufbau stabiler Cloud-Infrastrukturen ein. Auch im Bereich CI/CD verfügst Du über praktische Erfahrung, idealerweise mit GitLab, und verstehst, wie zuverlässige Deployment-Prozesse umgesetzt werden. Mit containerbasierten Technologien wie ECS sowie zentralen AWS-Services wie IAM hast Du bereits gearbeitet und kennst deren Einsatz im produktiven Umfeld. Komplexe Systemlandschaften kannst Du analysieren, weiterentwickeln und hinsichtlich Performance, Stabilität und Betrieb optimieren. Idealerweise hast Du zusätzlich Erfahrung im Big Data Umfeld gesammelt, beispielsweise mit AWS Lake Formation, Glue oder StepFunctions. Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und gerne im Team und bringst Deine Erfahrung aktiv in gemeinsame Lösungen ein. Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung aus regulierten oder KRITIS‑ähnlichen Umfeldern mit. Deine sprachlichen und schriftlichen Fähigkeiten sind sehr gut, in Deutsch und Englisch. Warum wir? Team & Kultur : Start-up-Spirit mit knapp 50 Mitarbeitenden an vier Standorten (Frankfurt, Leipzig, Hamburg, Berlin) oder remote. Regelmäßige Events wie wöchentliches Breakfast, Standort- und Teamevents sowie unser Company Day und die Weihnachtsfeier. Entwicklung & Weiterbildung : Strukturierte Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen, Weiterbildungsbudget und -zeit sowie Wissensaustausch über Meetups & Events. Raum für Deine Ideen und Mitgestaltung. Flexibilität & Benefits : Flache Hierarchien, familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten und Remote-Option. Unterstützung für Remote-Equipment, JobRad, Jobticket sowie Firmenfitness über EGYM Wellpass für nur 20 Euro im Monat. Wir begrüßen Diversität und möchten sie nach allen Kräften fördern. Daher richten wir uns an Menschen, nicht an ein Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Herkunft oder Glauben. Mach unsere Unternehmenskultur bunter!
